title: AI News Daily — September 9, 2026
summary: OpenAI says an unreleased model cracked the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize problem in 88 hours, then stands accused of pressuring a rival mathematician to drop his Anthropic-employed coauthor from credit. Meanwhile, an Anthropic researcher quit AI entirely, warning the race to self-improving models is "gambling with our lives." And Meta launched Muse, an agent with standing access to your email, payments, and calendar.
